title: Submagic alternative: free captions, not monthly
description: Submagic starts at $19 a month. Captions is free and works on your device: no upload, no account. English only. It captions a clip's first five minutes.
ogTitle: A Submagic alternative if captions are all you need
ogDescription: AI captions, made on your device. Free, not $19 a month.
h1: A Submagic alternative if captions are all you need
sub: AI captions, made on your device. No monthly bill.
body: Submagic starts at $19 a month, or $12 a month paid yearly, for 15 videos of up to two minutes ([their pricing page](https://www.submagic.co/pricing), 19 September 2026). Here it is free: no monthly bill, no video count, and it captions the first five minutes of any clip.
not: English only; Submagic captions many languages.
No extra footage, zooms or sound effects.
No cutting long videos into shorts.

questions.a: You can try it without a card, their pricing page says. Its plans start at $19 a month, or $12 a month paid yearly, for 15 videos of up to two minutes each, read on 19 September 2026. Here it is free, and it captions the first five minutes of any clip.
No. Captions is free, and there is nothing to renew.
No. Saved clips carry no mark.
